decided: Orbit always pushes to the change's own pull request branch on the project's chosen remote, and decides whether anything is left to push by comparing against that branch, never against another branch the checkout happens to follow.
alternatives: decide by the branch the checkout follows, which can be a different remote and so skip a push the pull request needs
why: The pull request shows only what reaches its own branch; it does not check the remote afresh, so a remote that lost commits is caught only at the next commit, which is stated as a known limit.
